notes.title: Simple Solitaire released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533018/4eb9056ae146c7db2975f07d55d485c02bbcc700.png[/img]

Do you want a light game to enjoy? Choose Simple Solitaire.

No additional payments, no ads, no stories... nothing unnecessary.
Made for you who only want to enjoy solitaire!

Have fun with Simple Solitaire!
